title: Berbere Lamb Stew
description: A hearty, flavorful stew made with lamb and berbere spice, perfect for a keto diet. This stew is warm and comforting, with a smoky depth from the spices.
instructions: Heat ghee or oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add lamb and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add berbere spice and cook for 1 minute.
Add chicken broth and water, and stir to combine.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 1 1/2 hours, or until lamb is tender.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley.
Serve with a side of cauliflower rice, if desired.
